name: xteve_guide2go
description: xteve, guide2go in one docker with cron setup guide2go SD subscrition as follows or copy your existing .json files into your mounted /guide2go folder docker exec -it "dockername" guide2go -configure /guide2go/"your_epg_name".yaml to test the cronjob functions docker exec -it dockername ./config/cronjob.sh included functions are (all can be individual turned on / off) xteve - iptv and epg proxy server for plex, emby, etc ... thanks to @marmei website: http://xteve.de Discord: https://discordapp.com/channels/465222357754314767/465222357754314773 guide2go - xmltv epg grabber for schedules direct, thanks to @marmei github: https://github.com/mar-mei/guide2go Schedules Direct web: http://www.schedulesdirect.org/ some small script lines cause i personally use tvheadend and get playlist for xteve and cp xml data to tvheadend

paths.name: /xteve
paths.description: where all data will be, when changing startup options with custom location u have to adjust here too

paths.name: /tmp
paths.description: /tmp/xteve/ in case u want buffering etc in RAMDISK

paths.name: /TVH
paths.description: /mnt/user/appdata/tvheadend/data/ in case TVH move functions are enabled u need to mount this
